profile.headline: Embedded Software Engineer
profile.summary: I am a graduate of the University of Florida with a bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering. I previously worked as an IT student assistant at the Registrar's Office at UF and I was the Project Manager in the student organization Gator Gaming which is UF's official gaming organization. I also have previous experience with customer service and retail from Winn-Dixie and Publix.

positions.locationName: Deerfield Beach, Florida, United States · On-site

positions.title: Senior IT Infrastructure Specialist
positions.description:
Deployed and managed new phone system using Dialpad VOIP solution.
Developed and delivered training materials and documentation to help users better understand and utilize the company's IT resources.
Provided guidance and mentorship to junior help desk technicians, sharing technical knowledge and best practices to improve the overall quality of service provided to users.
Participated in on-call rotations to provide after-hours support and ensure critical systems remained available and operational.
Learned how to use Salesforce Flows and Apex Triggers through Salesforce Developer Trail to improve the use of our ticketing system, Remedyforce.

positions.title: Information Technology Infrastructure Specialist
positions.description:
Conduct troubleshooting to resolve IT-related issues for 500+ users.
Managed user accounts and access rights using Active Directory and Microsoft Azure, ensuring 
compliance with company policies and procedures.
Manage ticketing system by creating and editing service requests and maintain workflow rules to provide seamless support to end-users and allow HelpDesk technicians to meet predetermined SLAs.
Project manager of facility buildout for IT to provide equipment and develop network landscape for the facility efficiently through communication and planning with the business and contractors.
